messages:
maria-l: Quick check — while closing Dec I see a revenue schedule gap for ACME hosted usage ~ $42,175. Looks like deferral didn't pick up the prepaid commit. Spreadsheet: https://go/finance/acme-dec-rec
acct-bot: Invoice INV-34872 from CloudRack posted to AP at 2399990010
samir: On it. Can you paste the sample rows? is this host vs dedicated split?
maria-l: Paste of relevant rows: invoice posted in Dec but revenue should start Jan per contract. Our rev_schedule keyed on invoice_date not start_date.
eva-f: That explains it. For cutover we usually run an adjusting entry. Suggested journal:
```
Period: Jan-2026 (open)
DR Deferred Revenue 42,175
CR Revenue - Hosted 42,175
Memo: Move prepaid commit from invoice_date to service start per contract ACME-2025-11
```
samir: Should DR be 'Unearned Revenue - Hosted' GL 2105? Also need approval from revops before posting.
jordan: FYI pricing experiment in Dec gave 10% intro credit for hosted — that reduced recognized amount; maybe double-counted with manual promo credit. See PR-478.
raj: I can approve the adjusting entry once acct extracts show no duplicate promo credits. @maria-l can you confirm?
maria-l: Confirmed: promo credit was applied on billing side, not revenue side. I attached ledger extract (rows).
samir: OK, will draft JE in NetSuite and set memo. I'll post copy here for review. ETA 30m :clock1:
samir: Draft JE (staging):
```
JE Date: 2026-01-05
Line 1: DR GL 2105 Unearned Revenue 42,175
Line 2: CR GL 4001 Hosted Revenue 42,175
Reference: ACME INV-34872 / SOW ACME-2025-11 / tag revtriage-239999
```
eva-f: :thumbsup: Looks good. One more ask — can we add BSEG tag 'revtriage-239999' for traceability?
samir: Added tag. Posting in 10.
acct-bot: Journal JE-90033 posted to staging at 2399990500 by samir (pending approval).
raj: Approved. Please ensure audit attachments include signed SOW and contract clause. :white_check_mark:
maria-l: Thanks all — I'll update month close checklist and follow up in close book. Closing thread.
